# Unicycive Therapeutics to Present at the Guggenheim 3rd Annual Healthcare Innovation Conference


November 04, 2026 7:05am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_18444ffc1941d4ea65f1af2591568900/unicycive/news/2026-11-04_Unicycive_Therapeutics_to_Present_at_the_129.pdf)


MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Unicycive Therapeutics, Inc. (“Unicycive” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: UNCY), a biotechnology company developing therapies for patients with kidney disease, today announced that Shalabh Gupta, M.D., Chief Executive Officer, will present at the Guggenheim 3rd Annual Healthcare Innovation Conference on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. ET.


A link to the live and archived webcast may be accessed on the Unicycive website under the Investors section:[Events and Presentations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=SBcFckQAtJY6fo645m7J4U6vIo3nVP7UABDpC_JBtmj1ULip-INasyS-AO8PdROa8llo9_0MZEyHF2PZ5bdWzS9qYpDhuN62FLbfnv7XcIIsCwjLNiO6VrUXTZlrwwqCa5TYJjfsrUu-xi6KX5pusA==) .


**About Unicycive Therapeutics**


Unicycive Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing novel treatments for kidney diseases. Unicycive’s lead investigational treatment is oxylanthanum carbonate, a novel phosphate binding agent for the treatment of hyperphosphatemia in patients with chronic kidney disease who are on dialysis. Unicycive’s second investigational treatment UNI-494 is intended for the treatment of conditions related to acute kidney injury. It has been granted orphan drug designation (ODD) by the FDA for the prevention of Delayed Graft Function (DGF) in kidney transplant patients and has completed a Phase 1 dose-ranging safety study in healthy volunteers.
